Title: Glamazons
Writer: Bryan Goluboff, Matthew K. Begbie, Anju Andre-Bergmann
Actors: Carrie Preston, Wendell Pierce, Laura Benanti
Plot: A fallen '90s supermodel returns to New York for a reunion and revenge, leading Elsbeth to sort through old grudges and lies to catch a killer. Meanwhile, Officer Hackett takes her turn in the spotlight
